placements.why: This envelope announces, justifies, and schedules a database/analytics-platform adoption — a technical infrastructure decision. No strata category exists yet in this repo to hold organizational-strategy content of this kind, and nothing supplied is even close, so a new top-level category is minted standalone per the NEW check, with no parent required.
placements.title: Technology and infrastructure choices form their own organizational category, distinct from strategy or product decisions.
placements.frame: What architecture and infrastructure decisions accumulate here, and on what technical grounds are they justified?

placements.title: Database and analytics-platform adoption is pronounced as settled fact, grounded in quantified performance, and bound to a scheduled rollout.
placements.frame: When a new data/analytics platform is adopted, what quantified performance rationale is offered, and how is the authority to decide and to schedule the migration exercised?
placements.why: src-1 performs the adoption of Zypherion as a settled decision, src-2 supplies the quantified performance rationale (15x faster columnar queries) that grounds it, and src-3 commits the org to a migration timeline — together a single recurring pattern (tech-adoption decisions pronounced top-down, justified by measured performance, and scheduled) that future infrastructure-decision envelopes will keep feeding, distinct from any one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata (both empty for this repo) plausibly holds this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly minted Architecture strata rather than standing fully orphaned.
